description: Synthetic English pipeline demonstration, NOT a scientific or multilingual benchmark.

cases.question: What combines dense and lexical search?
cases.reference_answer: Hybrid retrieval combines semantic vector search and BM25 keyword search. Reciprocal Rank Fusion merges ranked lists.

cases.question: How are citations verified?
cases.reference_answer: Page citations identify the document and page of each evidence passage. Exact source quotes make references verifiable.
